scientific_limitations: The rank of the entire magma monoid is not determined; the bound five for n>=3 is one-sided.
The full 2022 originating article was not accessible for line-by-line historical priority review; the known unit decomposition is treated as prior art.
An earlier general direct-product generation theorem might imply the rank formula; the claim is original only to the best of the accessible literature review.
The exhaustive checker covers only finite examples; the theorem for arbitrary n rests on the written proof.
title: Three generators for the units of every finite magma monoid and a five-generator obstruction
